name: Holden Beach
question_title: Can you drive a golf cart in Holden Beach?
answer_short: Street-legal LSVs yes, plain golf carts no. Ocean Isle Beach and Holden Beach only allow carts that are registered, inspected and insured as LSVs. In Holden Beach, LSVs may use roads posted 35 mph or less.

golf_cart.roads: Only if registered as an LSV
golf_cart.notes: Gas carts can't pass NC inspection

rules.rule: Must be registered, tagged and insured LSVs to use public streets
Golf carts aren't allowed on roads; registered, inspected and insured LSVs only
rules.citation: Town of Holden Beach ordinance summary

rules.rule: Registered, insured LSVs on roads posted 35 mph or less; may cross faster roads at intersections

banned_roads.name: Roads posted over 35 mph (e.g. NC 904, NC 130)

faq.q: Can I drive a regular golf cart in Holden Beach?
faq.a: No. Ocean Isle Beach and Holden Beach only allow carts that are registered, tagged and insured as LSVs.

faq.q: Can gas golf carts be street-legal in Ocean Isle Beach?
faq.a: No. The town says gas golf carts won't pass NC inspection, so they can't be registered.
